```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#installing packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(googlesheets4)
library(purrr)
library(vegan)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(janitor)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
#importing datasheet 
big_river_spring_recruitment = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10cycCffIPLnrWE9QSD1MXqvty4o4RwntHcomYzE3p6M/edit?gid=0#gid=0')

big_river_early_april_recruitment = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Zhjbl4z-xsj6EZJEwQ42Fs4pnPALJ4SW-X6S03eCDtY/edit?pli=1&gid=0#gid=0')
```

#APRIL 4th
```{r}
big_river_early_april_recruitment <-  big_river_early_april_recruitment%>%
  filter(site == "Big River") %>%
  clean_names()

#changing count columns from factor to numeric
big_river_early_april_recruitment$lamr <- as.numeric(big_river_early_april_recruitment$lamr)
big_river_early_april_recruitment$nerj <- as.numeric(big_river_early_april_recruitment$nerj)
big_river_early_april_recruitment$nera <- as.numeric(big_river_early_april_recruitment$nera)

#getting totals (sums of both transects per plot)
early_april_site_total <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE)) 

##by plot
early_april_plot_total <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(n_s,arkev,plot) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE)) 

##inshore vs. offshore
early_april_by_side <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(n_s) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
   Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE)) 


##by quadrant
early_april_quadrants <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::mutate(quadrant = dplyr::case_when(
    plot >= 6 & n_s == "N" ~ "NE",
    plot >= 6 & n_s == "S" ~ "SE",
    plot <= 5 & n_s == "N" ~ "NW",
    plot <= 5 & n_s == "S" ~ "SW")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(quadrant) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(quadrant)

##by treatment
early_april_treatment <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(arkev) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

early_april_site_total
early_april_by_side
early_april_quadrants
early_april_treatment
```

#April 4th Heatmaps
```{r}
#summarize to plot x side level
heatmap_df_4_4 <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(plot, n_s) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_All  = sum(lamr, nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_LAMR = sum(lamr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_NERJ = sum(nerj, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

#reshape to long format for faceting
heatmap_long_4_4 <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  heatmap_df_4_4,
  cols = c(Total_LAMR, Total_NERJ, Total_All),
  names_to = "species",
  values_to = "count")

#both species
ggplot(heatmap_long_4_4, aes(x = factor(plot), y = species, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_s, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e",
                      name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Big River Restoration Site: Species Counts by Plot",
    subtitle = "Summed across all transects | 2026-04-04",
    x = "ARKEV Plot (West → East)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50"))

#totals by species
species_long <- heatmap_long_4_4 %>%
  filter(species != "Total")

ggplot(species_long, aes(x = factor(plot), y = species, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_s, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e",
                      name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Big River Restoration Site: Species Counts by Plot",
    subtitle = "Summed across all transects | 2026-04-04",
    x = "ARKEV Plot (West → East)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50"))

#totals

totals_long <- heatmap_long_4_4 %>%
  filter(species == "Total_All")


ggplot(totals_long, aes(x = factor(plot), y = species, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), color = "gray20", size = 5) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_s, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e",
                      name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Big River Restoration Site: Species Counts by Plot",
    subtitle = "Summed across all transects | 2026-04-04",
    x = "ARKEV Plot (West → East)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray30"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50"))
```

```{r}
#base theme
heatmap_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      panel.grid    = element_blank(),
      axis.text     = element_text(color = "gray30"),
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50"))}

#totals per transects
heatmap_df <- big_river_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(plot, N_S) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    LAMR  = sum(LAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NERJ  = sum(NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total = sum(LAMR, NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

#plot 1: LAMR summed
p1 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = LAMR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "LAMR Counts by Plot",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 2: NERJ summed
p2 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = NERJ)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "NERJ Counts by Plot",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 3: Total (LAMR + NERJ) summed
p3 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = Total)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "Total Species Counts by Plot (LAMR + NERJ)",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()



# BY INDIVIDUAL BIN (adds transect_bin as a facet layer)


heatmap_bin <- big_river_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = LAMR + NERJ,
    bin_label = paste0("Bin ", transect_bin)
  )

#plot 4: LAMR by bin 
p4 <- ggplot(heatmap_bin, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = LAMR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(bin_label ~ N_S, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "LAMR Counts by Plot and Transect Bin",
       subtitle = "Not summed — each bin shown separately | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 5: NERJ by bin
p5 <- ggplot(heatmap_bin, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = NERJ)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(bin_label ~ N_S, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "NERJ Counts by Plot and Transect Bin",
       subtitle = "Not summed — each bin shown separately | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 6: Total by bin
p6 <- ggplot(heatmap_bin, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = Total)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(bin_label ~ N_S, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "Total Species Counts by Plot and Transect Bin (LAMR + NERJ)",
       subtitle = "Not summed — each bin shown separately | 2026-04-19",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

p1
p2
p3
p4
p5
p6
```

```{r}
#base theme
heatmap_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      panel.grid    = element_blank(),
      axis.text     = element_text(color = "gray30"),
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50"))}

#totals per transects
heatmap_df <- big_river_april_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(plot, N_S) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    LAMR  = sum(LAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NERJ  = sum(NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total = sum(LAMR, NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

#plot 1: LAMR summed
p1 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = LAMR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "LAMR Counts by Plot",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-05-05",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 2: NERJ summed 
p2 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = NERJ)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "NERJ Counts by Plot",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-05-05",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()

#plot 3: Total (LAMR + NERJ) summed
p3 <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = Total)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ N_S, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef5e0", high = "#1a6e2e", name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = as.character(1:10)) +
  labs(title = "Total Species Counts by Plot (LAMR + NERJ)",
       subtitle = "Summed across all transect bins | 2026-05-05",
       x = "Plot (West → East)", y = NULL) +
  heatmap_theme()



# BY INDIVIDUAL BIN (adds transect_bin as a facet layer)


heatmap_bin <- big_river_may_recruitment %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = LAMR + NERJ,
    bin_label = paste0("Bin ", transect_bin)
  )

#plot 4: LAMR by bin
p4 <- ggplot(heatmap_bin, aes(x = factor(plot), y = N_S, fill = LAMR)) +
```

```{r}
#standardize early april
early_april_std <- big_river_early_april_recruitment %>%
  rename(N_S = n_s, ARKEV = arkev, LAMR = lamr, NERJ = nerj) %>%
  mutate(date = "Early April") %>%
  group_by(date, site, plot, N_S, ARKEV, meter) %>%
  summarise(
    LAMR = sum(LAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NERJ = sum(NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(transect = meter)

#standardize late april and may
april_std <- big_river_april_recruitment %>%
  mutate(date = "Late April") %>%
  group_by(date, site, plot, N_S, ARKEV, transect_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    LAMR = sum(LAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NERJ = sum(NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(transect = transect_bin)

may_std <- big_river_may_recruitment %>%
  mutate(date = "May") %>%
  group_by(date, site, plot, N_S, ARKEV, transect_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    LAMR = sum(LAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NERJ = sum(NERJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(transect = transect_bin)

#combine
all_raw <- bind_rows(early_april_std, april_std, may_std) %>%
  mutate(
    ARKEV = recode(ARKEV, "NO ARKEV" = "Control"),
```

#2025 vs 2026 kelp recruitment
```{r}
arkev_data_2025 <- read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1jhqeuVwg7_icGaYOh5YpMcoPubQsDs3fn9fWGcZmFi4/edit?gid=1766421584#gid=1766421584')

arkev_data_2025 <- arkev_data_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    count   = as.numeric(unlist(count)))

#selecting for kelp data and early spring months
arkev_kelp_2025 <- arkev_data_2025 %>%
  dplyr::select(month, day, year, ARKEV_type, ARKEV_unit, data_type, species_code,count) %>%
  filter(month == c("4", "5")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, ARKEV_type, ARKEV_unit, data_type, species_code, count) %>%
  filter(data_type == "kelp") 

#cleaning up 
# Fill in missing combos of ARKEV_type × Date × species_code
  kelp_25_clean <- arkev_kelp_2025 %>%
   # complete(date, ARKEV_type, ARKEV_unit, data_type,species_code, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::select(date,ARKEV_type, ARKEV_unit, species_code, count) %>%
  filter(species_code %in% c("LAMR", "NERJ", "NO_KELP"))


#2025: sum circles per plot, calculate density
density_2025 <- kelp_25_clean %>%
  filter(species_code %in% c("LAMR", "NERJ")) %>%
  mutate(plot = as.numeric(gsub("[A-Za-z]", "", ARKEV_unit))) %>%
  mutate(date = case_when(
    date == as.Date("2025-04-24") ~ "Late April",
    date == as.Date("2025-05-08") ~ "Early May",
    date == as.Date("2025-05-25") ~ "Late May"
  )) %>%
  group_by(date, ARKEV_type, plot, species_code) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    density = count / (2 * pi),
    year = 2025
  ) %>%
  rename(ARKEV = ARKEV_type, species = species_code)

#2026: density per plot
density_2026 <- all_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(LAMR, NERJ),
               names_to = "species",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(date, ARKEV, plot, species) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    density = count / 120,
    year = 2026)

#Combine
density_combined <- bind_rows(density_2025, density_2026) %>%
mutate(
    year = factor(year),
    ARKEV = recode(ARKEV, "NO ARKEV" = "Control"),
    date = factor(date, levels = c("Early April", "Late April", "May", "Early May", "Late May")),
    ARKEV = recode(ARKEV, "NO ARKEV" = "Control"))
```

```{r}
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

fig1_2025

#Figure 2: NERJ only
fig2_2025 <- treatment_totals_2025 %>%

#Figure 3: LAMR and NERJ side by side
fig3_2025 <- treatment_totals_2025 %>%
  filter(species %in% c("LAMR", "NERJ")) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = c("LAMR", "NERJ"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ARKEV, y = mean_density, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ date, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("LAMR" = "brown4", "NERJ" = "green4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Big River Restoration Site: ARKEV vs. Control",
    subtitle = "Mean Density of Laminariales spp. recruits & Nereo Juveniles Across Plots | 04/24/2025, 05/08/2025, 05/25/2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Density (recruits/m²)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
```
